purpose: Prepare executable QA checks as soon as objective/done_when/source owner are known, without creating acceptance, release, scheduling or promotion authority.

binding.truth_boundary: Prepared QA is evidence design only. Existing product/Current/Human Accepted/Served gates remain authoritative.

preparable_before_artifact: source/static assertions derived from known source owner and invariants
contract/schema checks derived from objective and done_when
browser/click scripts whose selectors/actions/expected states are already specified
visual reference criteria and capture locations when objective defines them
E2E request/response or cross-device scenario skeletons with secrets/capabilities excluded

wait_rules.artifact: Execution requires final candidate bytes, generated output, build product or artifact identity not yet available.
wait_rules.served_runtime: Execution requires deployed/public bytes, network navigation, cross-device transport or runtime side effects.
wait_rules.human_only: A real taste, acceptance, irreversible authority or subjective decision is required; automation may prepare evidence but cannot decide it.

check_v1.blocking_rule: Never infer PRE_USABLE merely because a check exists. It must be explicit from safety/privacy/authority/irreversibility or the owned objective. Reversible candidate QA defaults to ASYNC_AFTER_CANDIDATE when existing policy permits candidate exposure.

parallelism.rule: QA-precompile may run while producer_state is IMPLEMENTING because it consumes objective/done_when/source owner, not unfinished bytes. Checks waiting for bytes/runtime remain prepared descriptors until their dependency arrives.
parallelism.fan_in: Every check names a consumer; validator/judge/integrator consumes executed evidence through existing portfolio/Guide mechanisms.
parallelism.anti_duplication: Do not launch duplicate producer work to create QA capacity. Prefer verifier/critic lanes and existing semantic successor dedup when materializing separate QA jobs.

candidate_delivery.rule: Do not block a reversible usable candidate solely because asynchronous QA is pending unless an explicit PRE_USABLE gate applies.
candidate_delivery.authority: These are projections/evidence states, not promotion authority.
